description: Sends a document to be translated (PDF, image or Office file, up to 25 MB): a file the user attached in chat as `document`, a public https `url`, or `content_base64` with its filename when you hold the bytes yourself. It is measured the way the order form measures an upload; the response carries the billable pages and a file_token to pass to get_quote and create_order, valid for 24 hours and one order. If none of these is possible, create the order from the customer's page count and they upload the document at the status_url after paying.

content_base64.description: The document's bytes encoded as base64, when you hold the file rather than a URL or an attachment. Send filename with it.

document.description: A file the user attached in the chat, passed as the host provides it. Use this for attachments; omit url and content_base64.

download_url.description: Temporary download URL of the attachment

file_id.description: The host's id for the attachment

mime_type.description: The attachment's MIME type, if known

filename.description: The document's filename with its extension, e.g. birth-certificate.pdf; required with content_base64.

url.description: A public https URL of the document, ending in its extension, e.g. https://files.example.com/birth-certificate.pdf. Omit when sending document or content_base64.

name: send_document
title: Send a document
